Author: Serpens66
Name: Multiplayer Restart Test
Description: Experimental host-only same-mission multiplayer restart through an automatically restored private lobby. New games only; identical testmod required on every peer.

Changes: Hold the host's one-shot start seed until every original participant has finished loading the replacement map, preventing loss to the lobby receiver and a black map.
Use the existing Vanilla Restart Mission button through APIShared's general Vanilla-action override API; clients cannot restart and no duplicate action is added.
Use restart protocol v3; every participant needs the same testmod and APIShared 0.64.0 or newer.
Use the game language for restart messages and short confirmation headings in every supported language.
Wait for production-rule agreement before automatically pressing Ready and limit retries after another start guard rejects the command.
Require APIShared 0.62.1 to recover the production-rule agreement after a lobby change.
